document.abstract: (These regulations are published herein for information and ready reference by the readers of the Journal. Publication in the Journal is therefore in no way related to approval or disapproval of these regulations by the Society, although much of the material relating to motion picture projection rooms has been based upon recommendations made by the Sub-Committee on Fire Hazards of the SMPE Projection Practice Committee, published in the November, 1938, issue of the Journal. The following regulations are reprinted from NBFU Pamphlet No. 40, July 1, 1939, copies of which may be obtained from the National Board of Fire Underwriters, New York, N. Y.)
